title: The Hunters' Mark
text: Fresh blood on the stones, bright and wet, a trail of it leading away between the rocks. It is not your blood. The quarry is hurt, and it is going somewhere it thinks is safe, and it is not being careful anymore.

options.label: The best tracker follows the blood wherever it leads, eager to finish what was started.

outcomes.text: The blood runs straight and fresh, a shortcut through the rocks to the very mouth of its lair.
The trail ends in a pool, and the pool was poured. The blood was bait, and the quarry is behind you.

options.label: Keep to the path and let it bleed. Wounded things are the most dangerous.

outcomes.text: Slower, and safer. When you do come on the quarry you come from cover, and the Leader is ready before it is.
